notes: Timestamps come from YouTube auto-captions (word-level), checked against contact sheets where 'verified' is 'frames'. Allow about 0.3 s slop at cut points.

The two courthouse clips get the vintage radio treatment in the film, so 2013 and 2018 footage ages fine; the sentencing anchor clips do not, so those lean on 2024 to 2026 material and the 2015 Ulbricht desk read.

No real 2025 or 2026 report pairs 'goes on trial today' with 'trial of the century' in one breath. Mangione's state trial (the obvious 2026 'trial of the century') was stayed in August 2026 on a double-jeopardy motion, so there is no day-one courthouse stand-up for it; Musk v. Altman (April to May 2026) was called that only by podcasts.

Best single source for both courthouse clips and the judge quote is the televised 16 July 2026 Woolwich Crown Court sentencing of Owen Flowers and Thalha Jubair (Scattered Spider, TfL hack): ITV's package has a reporter stand-up outside the court and HHJ Mark Turner on camera; Sky News Courts and the Daily Record carry the full remarks.
Connor Moucka (Snowflake) is sentenced 27 October 2026 in Seattle; re-run the sentencing searches after that date, the judge's words will be read by anchors that evening.
